meta.title: Free courses for GRE, GMAT, Bocconi, TOLC and IMAT
meta.description: Prepare for GRE, GMAT, Bocconi tests, TOLC-I, TOLC-E, TOLC-F and IMAT with free lessons, worked examples and short checks.

index.title: Courses
index.lead: Structured, free courses that teach each exam one idea at a time. Every lesson explains the concept, works original examples step by step, shows the common traps and ends with a short check.
index.summary: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} · {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} · about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
index.freeNote: The courses are free to read, with no account. Topic practice, timed sections and full simulations need a Single Exam Pass or Plus; the free diagnostic needs only an account.
index.english: The courses are written in English; the IMAT course is also in Italian.

course.summary: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} · {lessons, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} · about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
course.sources: Official sources for the exam facts
course.practiseBody: Each lesson links to topic practice on the same skill. Practice needs a Single Exam Pass or Plus; the free diagnostic needs only an account.
course.progressEmpty: Mark lessons complete as you go and your progress shows here (kept in this browser only).

lesson.checkIntro: Answer each question before you open its answer.
lesson.question: Question {number}
lesson.wrongOptions: Why the other options are wrong
lesson.authorship: Written by the UniExamer team with AI assistance. Every worked example and check question was re-solved by an independent checker before publication. No subject expert has reviewed this lesson yet. If you find a mistake, write to support@uniexamer.com.
lesson.original: All questions here are original and written for UniExamer; none comes from the test maker.

interactive.tryFirst: Try the problem yourself first, then reveal the working one step at a time.
interactive.checkIntro: Choose an answer to each question: you will see at once whether it is right, and why.
interactive.flashcardsIntro: Recall the answer before you flip each card, then say whether you knew it. Cards you miss come back at the end.
interactive.flip: Select the card to flip it.
interactive.undo: Select it again to undo. Progress is kept in this browser only.
